parsed.name: Robo HAT MM1 电机与转向控制板
parsed.name_en: Robo HAT MM1 Motor and Steering Controller
parsed.description: 用于机器人小车的PWM控制板，可将转向和油门指令转换为PWM脉冲输出，以驱动转向舵机和电机油门，并支持数值校验、限幅与安全关闭。
parsed.description_en: A PWM control board for robotic vehicles that converts steering and throttle commands into PWM pulse outputs to drive a steering servo and motor throttle, with value validation, clamping, and safe shutdown support.

actions.description: 将超出允许范围的控制值裁剪到有效区间。
actions.description_en: Clamp a control value that is outside the allowed range into the valid interval.

actions.description: 设置转向和油门的PWM脉冲值。
actions.description_en: Set the PWM pulse values for steering and throttle.

actions.description: 检查给定的PWM值是否有效。
actions.description_en: Check whether a given PWM value is valid.

actions.description: 将转向和油门命令写入PWM输出。
actions.description_en: Write steering and throttle commands to the PWM outputs.

actions.description: 执行一次转向和油门控制更新并输出PWM信号。
actions.description_en: Perform one steering and throttle control update and output PWM signals.

actions.description: 关闭控制板输出以安全停止设备。
actions.description_en: Shut down the controller outputs to safely stop the device.
